AboutHero.title: ABOUT
AboutHero.name: Ahmed Abdelal
AboutHero.role: Full-Stack Developer | Business Systems & Digital Products
AboutHero.description: I build software for real business needs — management systems, e-commerce platforms, dashboards, APIs, and custom web products. My focus is on understanding the workflow first, then building a solution that is clear, maintainable, and useful in daily operations.

paragraphs.p1: I am most interested in projects where software needs to support a real business process, not just display information. I start by understanding how the work is done, who is involved, and where the current friction exists.
paragraphs.p2: My work includes business management systems, inventory and purchasing workflows, e-commerce products, dashboards, booking experiences, APIs, and multilingual web platforms.
paragraphs.p3: I work across backend and frontend, but I pay particular attention to business rules, permissions, data flow, usability, and maintainability because these are the areas that determine whether a system works well after launch.
paragraphs.p4: I prefer clear, practical architecture over unnecessary complexity. The goal is to solve the current business need well while keeping the system ready for sensible future growth.
